items.title: Ethical Use of Data and Models (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Ethical Use of Data and Models' under topic 7.6 (PDF 102, printed 98).

blocks.text: Data ke akhlaqi istemal ka matlab logon ki privacy aur confidentiality (raaz rakhna) ka ehtram hai. Data sirf munasib ijazat (consent) se jama ho aur sirf usi maqsad ke liye use ho jis ke liye liya gaya. Machine learning models aise banaye jayein ke discrimination na karein. Hassas (sensitive) data ko be-ijazat rasai (unauthorized access) se bachaya jaye. Akhlaqi usool predictive models (andaza lagane wale models) ke ghalat istemal ko rokte hain. Model design mein transparency users ka bharosa banati hai. Data aur models ka zimmedarana istemal muashre par musbat asar dalta hai.
